title: Rustorio mod manifest
description: mod.json — one per mod directory. Read by com.rustorio.mod.ModJsonReader.

id.description: This mod's id, and the namespace every piece of its content is registered under.

entryPoint.description: Fully-qualified RustorioMod class inside <id>.jar. Omit for a data-only mod.

renames.description: oldId -> newId for building prototypes this mod renamed, so old saves still load.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in a mod list. Defaults to the id.

author.description: Shorthand for a single-author mod; ignored when "authors" is present.

minEngineVersion.description: Oldest engine this mod works against. An older engine refuses to load it, with a message naming both versions.
